title: Godot Response System
description: Data for the Godot Response System

oneOf.description: Concept, describes why the system is being queried

name.description: Name of the concept, e.g. IdleBark, GotHit, PlayerStare

description.description: Human-readable description of the concept. For example, actor is idle, actor just got hit

priority.description: Concepts default to a priority of `0`. Concepts with a higher priority (`1`, `2`, `3`, etc) will interrupt concepts with a lower priority (for example, to let a death noise interrupt normal dialogue). If `nopriority` is given as a concept's priority, that concept will never interrupt any other speech and the system will act as though no event is happening when other responses check for activity.

oneOf.description: This concept will never interrupt any other speech and the system will act as though no event is happening when other responses check for activity
Criteria, describes a set of matching facts

name.description: Name of the criteria set, e.g. NobodyTalkingNearby, Walking, OnPath. Always from the perspective of the actor being queried

matches.description: Set of fact comparisons. E.g. '"hurt"' matches if the fact is the string "hurt", '<30' matches if the fact is under 30, '>=10' matches if the fact is over or equal to 10

oneOf.description: Rule, set of criteria when, if matched, trigger one or more responses

name.description: Name of the rule, e.g. KatieIdle, MedicGotHurt. Usually prefixed with the name of the actor this rule targets

criteria.description: Space-separated list of criteria to require

responses.description: Space-separated list of response groups to trigger

flags.description: Optional flags for this rule to follow, e.g. matchonce (deactivate after triggering), etc

apply_actor_facts.description: Facts to apply to this actor once the rule has been triggered, e.g. '"asdf"' sets the string to a new value, '-1' would subtract one from a number, '+50%' adds 50% to a number

apply_world_facts.description: Facts to apply to the world once the rule has been triggered, e.g. '"asdf"' sets the string to a new value, '-1' would subtract one from a number, '+50%' adds 50% to a number

oneOf.description: Response group, has one or more responses to a matched rule

name.description: Name of the response group, e.g. KatieIdle, MedicGotHit, SarahRTKatiePetAllofyou

then.description: After the response, output to the given actor the given concept, e.g. `then: sarah KatieFlirtingSarah`

flags.description: Optional flags for this response to follow, e.g. matchonce (deactivate after triggering), etc

busyfor.description: Number of seconds to be busy for

criteria.description: Facts to match, same as matched in the criteria

text.description: What to say for this node. If this is a list of strings, choose one randomly

apply_world_facts.description: Facts to apply to the world

jump_to.description: Node to jump to, `END` ends the dialogue tree
